item.title: Isntree Mugwort Calming Deep Cleansing Balm 100ml
item.description:
[ISNTREE] Mugwort Calming Deep Cleansing Balm 100ml
✨ Soothing & Deep Cleansing in One Step! ✨

Experience a deep, refreshing cleanse with the ISNTREE Mugwort Calming Deep Cleansing Balm—your go-to solution for gentle makeup removal and calming care. Enriched with premium mugwort extract, this cleansing balm works to soothe sensitive skin while effortlessly dissolving makeup, sunscreen, and impurities.

🌿 Key Features:
Deep Cleansing Balm: Transforms from a balm to oil to milk, melting away stubborn makeup, dirt, and excess sebum.
Mugwort Extract (10%): Rich in antioxidants and soothing properties to calm irritated and sensitive skin.
Hydrating Formula: Leaves skin feeling clean and moisturized without stripping away essential moisture.
Hypoallergenic & Safe for All Skin Types: Free from harsh chemicals, artificial fragrances, and parabens, making it suitable even for sensitive skin.

🧴 How to Use:
Take a small amount of the balm and gently massage it onto dry skin.
Watch the balm transform into an oil as it melts away makeup and impurities.
Add a bit of water to emulsify the product into a milky texture, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
Follow with your regular skincare routine.

✨ Main Ingredients:
Mugwort Extract (10%): Calms and hydrates while providing antioxidant protection.
Centella Asiatica: Known for its healing and anti-inflammatory properties.
Sunflower Seed Oil: Helps moisturize and nourish the skin.

📏 Volume: 100ml

👩‍🔬 Suitable for: All skin types, including sensitive skin

💯 Why Choose ISNTREE Mugwort Cleansing Balm?
Perfect for everyday use to keep your skin balanced, clear, and irritation-free.
A gentle formula that respects your skin’s natural barrier while giving it a deep, calming cleanse.

📌 100% Authentic – Official ISNTREE Store
Shop with confidence! This product is sourced directly from ISNTREE’s official store, guaranteeing you receive only genuine, high-quality skincare products. ✨
